item.title: Astrogación, Drivespace
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill involves navigation through drivespace, usually movement between star systems.

Starfall Results

  • Critical Failure/Failure: Consult “Drivespace Off Course Results”.
  • Ordinary: Arrive at the edge of the destination star system.
  • Good: Arrive inside destination star system, d12+2 AUs from target.
  • Amazing: Arrive inside destination system, d4 AUs from target.

item.title: Astrogación, Sistema
item.description:
This specialty skill involves navigation through normal space, usually within a star system.

System Astrogation Results

  • Critical Failure/Failure: Consult “System/Surface Off Course Results”.
  • Ordinary: Course is plotted at normal travel time plus d4 time units.
  • Good: Course is plotted at normal travel time.
  • Amazing: Course is plotted that cuts travel time by 1 time unit.

item.title: Navegación, Superficie
item.description:
This specialty skill is the study and performance of navigation on a planetary surface using stars, landmarks, and specialized equipment.

Surface Navigation Results

  • Critical Failure/Failure: Consult “System/Surface Off Course Results”.
  • Ordinary: Course is plotted at normal travel time plus d4 time units.
  • Good: Course is plotted at normal travel time.
  • Amazing: Course is plotted that cuts travel time by 1 time unit.

item.title: Pionero
item.description:
With trailblazing, a hero learns to find paths through rough terrain or create paths that others can use to move faster and cover more ground during a full day’s travel.

The successful use of this skill reduces the adverse effects of traveling in conditions of Good or Amazing difficulty for the hero and any companions who are traveling with him.

Results

  • Critical Failure: Route is worse than normal; everyone suffers an additional +1 penalty to fatigue checks.
  • Failure: No help is provided.
  • Ordinary: Reduction of 1 step to any penalties.
  • Good: Reduces penalties by 2 steps.
  • Amazing: Reduces penalties by 3 steps.
